name: Lesson 4: Prepositions & Conjunctions
descriptionHtml:
1. Question type

This part asks you to choose the correct answer to fill in the blank by identifying which preposition or conjunction is needed. 

 

2. Guide to answer

- With sentences asking to choose the correct prepositions, you need to familiarize yourself with the ways prepositions are commonly used. This will help you eliminate wrong answers quickly. For example, we often use the preposition “at” for a precise time; “in” for months, years, centuries and long periods; “on” for days and dates. 

- For questions testing conjunctions, you need to compare the two halves of the sentence and consider their relationship. Use this information to help you choose the correct conjunction.
